div.div:
Plan
• Locations form a tree (building → floor → room → spot); their shape feeds the web's floor plan.
• An item has one current location and one current holder; every change adds an Assignment, so the history stays.
• Users live in the user-service: only the id is stored here. On UserDeleted the item-service closes that user's assignments.
